items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: Bunck's one of the originals and maybe Joe Oliver is and then Louie sort of followed them

ctx.x: I don't mean that you, I think that you come up to his greatness or anything like that. I mean just sort of the feeling of it. Well maybe so. Maybe it all came out of the same, same bunch of guys.

Yeah, I listened, yeah well that's right. If you listen to anybody who played after Louie you tend to, tend to get a lot of Louie through that too. Yeah, yeah, that's right. Though I don't think Percy, that's the thing. I mean, if ever you can sort of pin down an influence of everybody. I mean you can sort of say, well, Bunck's one of the originals and maybe Joe Oliver is and then Louie sort of followed them but he's an original too. And then after that, everybody built on that.
